r0.t: Great serenity, with a flushed, red face

r1.t: Bright mind, fever heat and sweat

r3.t: Waking with sorrowful ideas about midnight

r6.t: Sadness, and restless toss¬ ing about

r13.t: Lamentation and moaning, wringing of hands day and night, much thirst, with but little ap¬ petite, although she swallows food hastily

r15.t: Hastiness, speaks hastily, with great agitation, spasms

r16.t: Hastiness, speaks hastily, as if drunken

r19.t: Difficult comprehension, coldness, with burning heat, talking from 4 p.m. all night

r25.t: Comes when getting conscious, with a stupid feeling in the head, is intense, but after drinkiug once, it is gone

r28.t: Frightened in sleep, burning heat, very little thirst
